home.title: Know what you're signing
home.description: Point your camera at any petition. We'll tell you what it is, what it does, and whether it's real, in plain language.

permission.title: Camera Access Needed
permission.description: To scan petitions, we need access to your camera. Your images are processed securely and never saved to your device.
permission.deniedDescription: Camera access was denied. To scan petitions:
permission.unsupportedDescription: Your browser doesn't support camera access. Try using Chrome, Safari, or Firefox on a mobile device.

exclusion.notice: This area is not captured to protect the privacy of signers

prompt.title: Add Scan Location?
prompt.description: Adding your location helps track where petitions are being circulated. Your exact position is never stored — we round to roughly a city block (~100m) for privacy.

denied.title: Location Access Denied
denied.description: Location access was denied. You can continue without sharing your location.

results.title: Scan Results
results.personalizedLoading: Reading this measure against your interests...
results.personalizedAiLabel: AI-generated from your declared interests and life context
results.personalizedSignInTitle: See what this means for you
results.personalizedSignInBody: Sign in and Opus Populi will read this measure against the interests and life context you've declared.
results.signingExplainer: This is the official measure you'd be signing to put on the ballot.
results.extractingDescription: Using AI to extract text from your image
results.analyzingDescription: Our AI is reviewing the petition content
results.extractedTextLabel: Extracted petition text (editable if OCR errors)
results.promptVersionTooltip: This analysis used prompt version {{version}} ({{hash}}). Prompts are independently auditable.
results.notAPetitionTitle: This doesn't appear to be a petition
results.notAPetitionBody: We read the document, and it doesn't look like a petition or ballot measure. If you believe this is wrong, please report it below — otherwise try scanning the petition itself.
results.unreadableTitle: We couldn't read enough of this document
results.unreadableBody: The photo didn't yield enough legible text to analyze. Try again with more light, less glare, and the full page in frame.

activityFeed.noActivity: No petition activity in the last 24 hours. Be the first to scan!

report.buttonLabel: Report an issue with this analysis
report.title: What's wrong with this analysis?
report.success: Report submitted. Thank you for your feedback.
report.error: Failed to submit report. Please try again.
report.alreadyReported: You have already reported this document.
